stories.title: How Digital Payments Work at Light Speed (Hindi) — Locked Narrator
stories.description: A single front-facing Indian lady narrator explains how digital payments work, with one locked identity reference across all scenes.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of a modern Indian woman narrator (age 35–40), calm and confident, facing directly toward the camera. Natural Indian facial features, medium brown skin tone, expressive eyes, neat hair, modern solid-color kurta or blazer-style top. She is speaking clearly, lips articulating naturally. No microphone, no handheld objects. Front-facing camera only. Chest and face square to camera. No side view, no profile view. Background: ultra-cinematic outdoor market with people using smartphones, one scanning a QR code, another tapping to pay, another checking a phone. Natural daylight, cinematic depth of field, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: subtle forward movement, gentle head nods while speaking, background crowd motion, camera tracking backward on straight axis, no rotation, stable framing
scenes.narration: आपने फोन टैप किया और कुछ ही सेकंड में भुगतान हो गया। लेकिन यह जादू नहीं है, यह एक पूरा सिस्टम है। यह सिस्टम इतने तेज़ी से काम कैसे करता है?

scenes.visual_prompt: Same location. The same Indian woman narrator continues speaking while staying front-facing to camera. No microphone, no handheld objects. Chest and face square to camera at all times. In the background, a customer holds a smartphone with a clean generic payment screen showing an amount like 250 and a clear pay/send action. No real app UI, no logos. Natural daylight, cinematic realism, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: steady forward walk, gentle hand emphasis while speaking, background finger tapping on phone, camera tracking backward on straight axis, continuous mouth movement, stable framing
scenes.narration: सब कुछ तब शुरू होता है, जब आप रकम दर्ज करते हैं और भुगतान का बटन दबाते हैं। आपका फोन उस जानकारी को सुरक्षित तरीके से पैक करता है, ताकि कोई बीच में उसे बदल न सके।

scenes.visual_prompt: Same narrator remains dominant in the foreground, speaking directly to the viewer, front-facing only. No microphone. Chest and face square to camera. Background: elegant glowing light rays and flowing energy lines rise from the sender’s phone and travel rapidly through the air, symbolizing secure digital signals moving across connected systems and servers. Light effects are smooth and cinematic, not sci-fi weapons. Realistic modern market environment, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: smooth light rays traveling quickly, gentle glow pulses, narrator steady with controlled gestures, camera stable on straight axis, continuous lip movement
scenes.narration: फिर यह रिक्वेस्ट नेटवर्क के ज़रिए सर्वर तक जाती है। वहाँ सिस्टम जांच करता है कि पिन कोड सही है, खाते में पर्याप्त बैलेंस है, और रिक्वेस्ट असली है। सब कुछ सही होते ही आगे की मंजूरी तुरंत मिल जाती है।

scenes.visual_prompt: Same location. The narrator remains front-facing in the foreground, speaking calmly with direct eye contact. No microphone. Chest and face square to camera. Background: a shopkeeper checks a smartphone showing a generic confirmation with the same amount received like 250 received and a success check mark. No real app UI, no logos. Light rays gently converge into the phone and fade. Natural daylight, cinematic realism, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: phone confirmation appearing, soft glow fading, slight nod from receiver, narrator steady while speaking, camera stable on straight axis, continuous lip movement
scenes.narration: जैसे ही पुष्टि होती है, रिसीवर के फोन पर तुरंत संदेश आ जाता है कि भुगतान मिल गया। इसी दौरान पैसा सीधे एक बैंक से दूसरे बैंक में दर्ज हो जाता है।

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic close-medium shot of the same Indian woman narrator, reflective and reassuring, speaking directly to the viewer. Front-facing only, chest and face square to camera. No microphone, no objects. Background softly blurred market environment, no digital effects. Natural daylight, realistic modern setting, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: very slow forward movement easing into stillness, gentle head nods, continuous mouth movement, camera settles smoothly, stable framing
scenes.narration: ध्यान रहे, कोई ऐप आपका पैसा अपने पास नहीं रखती। ऐप केवल संदेश आगे बढ़ाती है, और असली लेन-देन आपके बैंक और सामने वाले के बैंक के बीच होता है।

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of the outdoor market continuing its normal rhythm. The same narrator remains visible and front-facing in the foreground while finishing her line. No side angles. People walk, trade, smile, and put phones away in the background. Natural sunlight, calm atmosphere. Cinematic realism, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: gentle crowd movement, narrator steady front-facing while speaking, camera stable on straight axis, soft ambient motion
scenes.narration: इसीलिए यह सिस्टम हर समय बैकग्राउंड में चलता रहता है, और हमारी ज़िंदगी बिना रुके आगे बढ़ती रहती है।
